description: This file contains wrapper functions around zlib compression library to handle errors and manage streaming compression/decompression within the project. It includes initialization, cleanup, and error reporting functions for zlib streams, with project-specific error handling and buffer management.

methods.name: const char * zerr_to_string(int status)
methods.description: Converts zlib error codes to human-readable strings.

methods.name: uInt zlib_buf_cap(unsigned long len)
methods.description: Caps buffer sizes to a maximum limit for zlib operations.

methods.name: void zlib_pre_call(git_zstream * s)
methods.description: Prepares zlib stream for operation by copying state from project-specific stream to zlib stream.

methods.name: void zlib_post_call(git_zstream * s,int status)
methods.description: Updates project-specific stream state after zlib operation, checking for consistency and managing buffer offsets.

methods.name: void git_inflate_init(git_zstream * strm)
methods.description: Initializes a zlib inflation stream with default settings.

methods.name: void git_inflate_init_gzip_only(git_zstream * strm)
methods.description: Initializes a zlib inflation stream configured specifically for gzip format.

methods.name: void git_inflate_end(git_zstream * strm)
methods.description: Ends inflation stream processing, freeing resources.

methods.name: int git_inflate(git_zstream * strm,int flush)
methods.description: Performs inflation (decompression) on the zlib stream with error handling.

methods.name: unsigned long git_deflate_bound(git_zstream * strm,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Calculates the maximum possible size of compressed data for a given input size.

methods.name: void git_deflate_init(git_zstream * strm,int level)
methods.description: Initializes a deflate (compression) stream with default settings.

methods.name: void do_git_deflate_init(git_zstream * strm,int level,int windowBits)
methods.description: Helper for initializing deflate with specific window bits settings.

methods.name: void git_deflate_init_gzip(git_zstream * strm,int level)
methods.description: Initializes a deflate stream configured for gzip compression.

methods.name: void git_deflate_init_raw(git_zstream * strm,int level)
methods.description: Initializes a deflate stream without zlib headers (raw deflate).

methods.name: int git_deflate_abort(git_zstream * strm)
methods.description: Aborts a deflate stream and releases resources.

methods.name: void git_deflate_end(git_zstream * strm)
methods.description: Ends deflate stream processing, releasing resources and handling errors.

methods.name: int git_deflate_end_gently(git_zstream * strm)
methods.description: Ends deflate stream processing, similar to git_deflate_end but intended for gentler cleanup.

methods.name: int git_deflate(git_zstream * strm,int flush)
methods.description: Performs compression on the zlib stream with error handling.

ctags.name: do_git_deflate_init
ctags.pattern: /^static void do_git_deflate_init(git_zstream *strm, int level, int windowBits)$/
